reviews.title: Reliable
reviews.comment: Been running for almost a year without issue, keeps the CPU cool and runs very quiet.
reviews.author: Koiffeine

reviews.title: Great budget aio!
reviews.comment: I am beyond impressed with this aio. My Thermaltake 240 aio pump finally died after oh 6 years or so. I did a case swap and when i installed my old aio and started the PC, sure enough it decided to die on me so i went looking for a cost effective replacement. I think this aio came in at $38 or something and it is worth twice that for sure! I haven't had my 5800xd3 get over 50c under any amount of load, hours on end, this thing comes to temp and keeps it there. It's a great cooling solution if you're on a bit of a budget but need water cooling for your CPU. A great product!
reviews.author: Anthony

reviews.title: Cooler looks great, cools great!
reviews.comment: I don't know why this is a "Frequently Returned Item" it works fantastic!  Easy to install, looks great, LEDs are bright, fans are quiet and cools even a big Ryzen 9 7900X easy. Build quality is good, no bent fins, pump is quiet. Plugged right into the fan, pump and ARGB headers on my motherboard. At less than $50, it's a great deal for a budget build.
reviews.author: TurboFroggy

reviews.title: Does the job at a very good price.
reviews.comment: So Far so good. Cooling my Overclocked 9600X @ 5.7ghz with no unervolting well. For the price, cant be beat. Lets see how long it lasts. My old corsair AIO was still working 9 years late, then i upgraded to AM5 and finally decided to replace it with this one.
reviews.author: Mach 1 Padilla

reviews.title: Muy buen rendimiento y excelente estética
reviews.comment: El Thermalright Aqua Elite 240 ARGB V4 ofrece muy buen rendimiento térmico. Desde que lo instalé, la CPU se mantiene a bajas temperaturas incluso bajo carga. La instalación fue sencilla y el sistema funciona de manera muy silenciosa. La iluminación ARGB le da un toque moderno al equipo y la calidad de construcción se siente sólida. Excelente opción si buscas refrigeración líquida eficiente a buen precio. 👍
reviews.author: andres piñeres
